en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of Onil
en.summary: A stolen Host and its gold vessel were found intact in a field and have been venerated ever since.
en.body: In 1824, a consecrated Host stolen along with its gold vessel from a church in Onil, Spain, was later recovered undamaged in a nearby field. It has been kept and venerated in the parish church as an incorrupt relic since.
